results.title: Teddy Bridgewater steps away from Lions, leaving question at backup QB
results.description: Veteran quarterback Teddy Bridgewater has stepped away from football. Detroit Lions coach Dan Campbell told reporters that Sunday, when Bridgewater was placed on the reserve/retired list.

results.title: T10 is part of cricket's headlong race to the bottom. But here's why Sussex's proposal for a FIFTH format in an already full to bursting calendar should really concern fans, writes LAWENCE BOOTH
results.description: LAWRENCE BOOTH: The suggestion by the new chairman of Sussex that a T10 competition may be one way of easing the financial concerns of the non-Hundred counties isn't just a sign of the times.
